Calcutta High Court Halts Demolition of Abhishek Banerjee's Office

The Calcutta High Court has ordered a halt to the demolition of Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee's office in Diamond Harbour. The court issued a status quo order during an urgent Sunday hearing. Banerjee had criticized the West Bengal police, calling them "lawbreakers" following the demolition.
